business.summary: Gas-to-ammonia-to-solutions group. Three businesses after the 2024 restructuring: Mining Chemicals (technical ammonium nitrate, TAN, for explosives; in Deepak Mining Solutions Ltd, DMSL, which also owns the 500 ktpa Taloja ammonia plant through Performance Chemiserve Ltd, PCL, and Platinum Blasting Services in Australia), Industrial Chemicals (nitric acid, IPA, methanol, liquid CO2; in the listed parent DFPCL) and Crop Nutrition (Mahadhan AgriTech Ltd, MAL: NP 24:24:0, NPK, Croptek crop-specific blends, Bensulf, water-soluble fertilisers). Reported Ind AS segments: Chemicals (Mining + Industrial chemicals + ammonia) and Fertilisers.

callPoints: Call held 30/31-Jul-2026 (transcript filed 6-Aug-2026; the company-website copy is behind bot protection, so we rely on the presentation and published call summaries).
First Equinor LNG cargo arrived in May-2026; full-quarter benefit from Q2FY27; potential savings ~Rs300 cr a year once the transition is complete, depending on crude and Henry Hub.
Ammonia debottlenecked by ~10%; Q1 utilisation 94%; ~80% of output used captively.
Ammonia ~$600/t ME FOB at the time of the call; management expects elevated prices for two to three quarters, then a 'new normal'.
New plants targeted at ~80% utilisation by Q4FY27; EBITDA contribution from Q3-Q4FY27; peak capex cycle nearly over; deleveraging from FY27; project interest capitalised until start-up.
No formal guidance: 'too early to provide full-year EBITDA margin guidance'. Q2 seasonally soft (monsoon); phosphoric acid and sulphur supply strained; subsidy corrections needed.
DMSL listing: committed, IPO vs demerger still being evaluated, no decision.

points: CFO: FY27 capex 'almost Rs800 crores to Rs1,000 crores ... including maintenance'; from FY28 'a normal maintenance capex'.

Gopalpur ~95% and Dahej ~86% complete at end-May; commissioning moved from Q4FY26 to Q1FY27 to Q2FY27 on a shortage of skilled contract labour (state elections, LPG shortage); 'within the approved capex envelope'.
Gopalpur to reach 90-95% utilisation on a TPD basis by end-FY27 (later revised to ~80% by Q4FY27 on the Q1 call).
DMSL CCDs: Rs500 cr from a third party and Rs300 cr from a promoter entity, issued in Q1FY26; fixed conversion ratio; conversion ~30 months after issue.
Chardham Chemicals (explosives unit, ~Rs120 cr, no revenue) bought to move DMSL from product to 'holistic mining solutions'.
Ammonia: 'our margin in ammonia business will be significantly better'; ME FOB ~$800/t in May-2026.
Gas: take-or-pay contract with a local supplier plus the 15-year Equinor contract; 'fully secured'.
Subsidiary listing/demerger: 'not immediately ... yet to take a call'.

history.event: Incorporated; ammonia-based chemicals and fertilisers at Taloja (Maharashtra).
Record year: revenue Rs11,301 cr, PAT Rs1,221 cr on war-time chemical and fertiliser prices; board approves the demerger of mining chemicals and crop nutrition (Dec-2022).
500 ktpa Taloja ammonia plant capitalised (fixed assets Rs2,678 cr -> Rs6,258 cr); spreads collapse, EPS falls to Rs35.9.
NCLT-approved restructuring completed: TAN, ammonia and Australian blasting into DMSL; crop nutrition into MAL; EPS Rs74.0.
DMSL raises Rs800 cr of CCDs (Apr-2025); buys the last 15% of Platinum Blasting (AUD10.7 mn); EBITDA -13% on fertiliser input costs, IPA and the ammonia turnaround; net debt up to Rs4,824 cr.
Equinor LNG starts (May-2026); Chardham Chemicals explosives unit acquired (6-May-2026, Rs121 cr); record Q1 EBITDA Rs845 cr; Gopalpur and Dahej commissioning guided for Q2FY27.
